catalog.title: Original Brand Website
catalog.summary: An original, conversion-focused website for a business, product or organisation invented by the model.
catalog.requirement: Distinct identity and offer; 5+ useful sections; offering details; validated enquiry flow; responsive and accessible design

catalog.title: Interactive Editorial Feature
catalog.summary: A substantial editorial experience combining original storytelling, evidence, data visualisation and meaningful interaction.
catalog.requirement: 800–1,100 words; 3 linked visualisations; transparent sources and methodology; accessible data view; responsive scrollytelling

catalog.title: Commerce Marketplace
catalog.summary: A complete, interactive marketplace with an original catalogue, discovery tools, cart logic and a simulated transaction flow.
catalog.requirement: 10+ coherent catalogue items; search and filters; detailed item views; validated cart maths; simulated checkout; persistent state

catalog.title: Interactive Data Dashboard
catalog.summary: A dense but clear operational dashboard with consistent data, linked metrics, drill-downs and a controllable event simulation.
catalog.requirement: 24+ coherent records; reconciled KPIs; 3 linked charts; composable filters; record detail; deterministic events; CSV export

catalog.title: Project Workspace
catalog.summary: A local-first workspace for managing multi-step work through synchronized views, editing, history and portable data.
catalog.requirement: 3 projects and 15+ work items; CRUD; synchronized Kanban, table and calendar views; filters; activity history; JSON round-trip

catalog.title: 2D Puzzle Game
catalog.summary: An original, fully playable 2D puzzle game with a distinctive mechanic, fair challenges and satisfying feedback.
catalog.requirement: Original mechanic; 6+ solvable stages; readable rules and state; undo/restart; keyboard and touch; saved progress

catalog.title: 3D Exploration Game
catalog.summary: An original 3D game world built around exploration, spatial interaction and a rewarding player objective.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D environment; responsive player and camera; interactive world elements; objective and progression; responsive controls; rendering fallback

catalog.title: Interactive System Simulation
catalog.summary: A transparent, deterministic simulation of a chosen dynamic system with coupled state, scenarios and live visual analysis.
catalog.requirement: 4+ coupled state variables; documented model and numerical method; 3 scenarios; 4 live plots; deterministic controls; CSV export

catalog.title: Creative Design Studio
catalog.summary: A real browser-based creative editor with editable elements, layered composition, history and useful file export.
catalog.requirement: Editable composition; object/layer management; transforms and style controls; undo/redo; save/import/export; valid SVG and PNG

catalog.title: Browser Music Studio
catalog.summary: An expressive browser-based instrument or music workstation with generated audio, performance controls and portable projects.
catalog.requirement: 4 distinct sound sources or voices; expressive controls; stable timing; transport; save/import; valid audio export

catalog.title: 3D Colony Builder
catalog.summary: A playable 3D settlement simulation where construction, inhabitants and resource systems shape a changing world.
catalog.requirement: Explorable 3D world; construction; autonomous agents; resource gathering and production; logistics; progression; save/load

catalog.title: Voxel Sandbox Game
catalog.summary: A genuinely editable 3D voxel world with exploration, construction and a satisfying player-driven activity loop.
catalog.requirement: Editable 3D voxel terrain; movement; mining and placement; inventory; meaningful crafting or progression; persistent world

catalog.title: 2D Action Brawler
catalog.summary: A complete side-scrolling 2D action game with responsive combat, distinct enemies and a satisfying encounter arc.
catalog.requirement: Playable character; responsive movement and combat; reliable hit detection; distinct enemy behaviours; stage progression; final encounter; keyboard/touch

catalog.title: 3D Racing Game
catalog.summary: A playable 3D driving experience with satisfying vehicle handling, a designed course and a clear competitive objective.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D vehicle and course; acceleration/braking/steering; collisions or boundaries; race objective; HUD; restart; saved result

catalog.title: Action Roguelite
catalog.summary: A replayable action game with evolving runs, meaningful upgrades, varied encounters and a complete run-ending challenge.
catalog.requirement: Replayable run structure; responsive action/combat; varied encounters; meaningful upgrades; escalation; final challenge; run results

runs.notes: Interactive bench audit with three visualisations, district explorer, and bench-level table. Browser-tested in Chromium (metric toggle, district filter, inspector, compare, table search, no console errors); data is constructed and illustrative.
